memories.content: Setup agentmemory su PC Windows 49359: (1) iii-engine v0.11.2 in C:\Users\49359\.local\bin\iii.exe; (2) script di avvio persistente C:\Users\49359\.local\bin\start-agentmemory.ps1 — verifica porta 3111, avvia 'cmd /c npx @agentmemory/agentmemory' come Start-Process Hidden con redirect log in %USERPROFILE%\.agentmemory\logs, attende readiness 60s; dashboard http://localhost:3113, REST http://localhost:3111, streams ws://3112. Server va riavviato con questo script se netstat non mostra LISTEN su 3111. (3) Convertitore sessioni OpenCode→JSONL Claude Code: C:\Users\49359\.local\bin\convert-opencode-to-jsonl.ps1 — esporta via 'opencode export <sesID>' (mostra solo sessioni della directory corrente!), converte parts text in JSONL senza BOM in C:\Users\49359\.opencode-jsonl, poi 'npx @agentmemory/agentmemory import-jsonl <dir>' (già testato: 2 sessioni, 6 osservazioni OK, visibili in tab Replay). (4) API REST 128+ endpoint /agentmemory/* su 3111; condivisione: AGENTMEMORY_SECRET bearer token per esposizione remota (solo 3111, viewer 3113 resta loopback, tunnel SSH per remoto), TEAM_MODE=shared+TEAM_ID+USER_ID per team feed, POST /agentmemory/mesh/peers + mesh/sync push/pull/both per federazione tra istanze (richiede AGENTMEMORY_SECRET su entrambi i peer, URL pubblici no-localhost). UTENTE RICHIEDE: avviare sempre il server agentmemory nelle chat e usare la dashboard 3113.

memories.content: Data dir di agentmemory spostata da %APPDATA%\agentmemory a 'C:\Users\49359\OneDrive - LEONARDO S.P.A\Agentmemory' per condivisione tra PC. Configurazione: (1) variabile d'ambiente UTENTE AGENTMEMORY_DATA_DIR impostata via setx (NOTA: il ~/.agentmemory/.env NON viene caricato in process.env dal CLI, la variabile .env è solo documentativa — parseEnvFile è usato solo da doctor); (2) start-agentmemory.ps1 passa --data-dir esplicitamente (precedenza massima). La data dir contiene state_store.db\ (cartella con .bin: memories, sessions, obs, lessons, crystals, health, audit, indici BM25), stream_store\ e iii-config.yaml (runtime, riscritto dal CLI con writeRuntimeIiiConfig). Verificato funzionante: engine scrive su OneDrive, dati integri (15 lessons + 2 memories + 2 sessions + 2 crystals). ATTENZIONE: OneDrive sincronizza i .bin — usare UN SOLO PC alla volta per evitare conflitti/corruzione. Per condividere su un secondo PC: installare iii-engine, impostare AGENTMEMORY_DATA_DIR (setx) o usare --data-dir con lo stesso percorso OneDrive. Fermare il server con 'npx @agentmemory/agentmemory stop --force' prima di modificare i file.

memories.content:
PROJECT STATE (2026-10-01) - DART Flight Analytics Explorer. Updated from session transcript explore-request.json (session ses_f136d5fa0ffeYU9Sa7X2PbzTQo, origin dir Y:\PRODUCT_LINES\AW189_EXT\SHARE\MAGGIULLI\Flights_Data).

GOAL: multi-agent system that generates MATLAB flight-data figures based on the user's analysis objective, with iterative conversation about figures. User always wants: team of collaborating subagents per task, agent memory updated always, responses in Italian.

DATA (server share): Y:\PRODUCT_LINES\AW189_EXT\SHARE\MAGGIULLI\Flights_Data\AW149S\AW149P6\{Flt_803,Flt_805,Flt_806}.
SANDRAmatdata structure: <flight>\SANDRAmatdata\c+NNN or c-NNN (pre-top '-' / top '+')\<SIGNAL>_<SOURCE>__LAB_<code>.mat. Each .mat = ONE struct named like the file, fields: t (double Nx1, dt=0.03125 s = 32 Hz), engValue (double Nx1), validity (1/0 flag), info (metadata). Flt_803: 59,302 files total; consolidated Honeywell LR110 signals = files matching *_LR110_2_OUT__LAB_*.mat (1,332 files, excluding _SSM, FAIL_CODE, _DISCRETE) -> 37 unique signals. DART also auto-selects other matdata types: DTSmatdata, HEROmatdata, SOLOmatdata, OEMmatdata, FDMmatdata, FDRmatdata.

HELIANALYSIS PIPELINE (local Flight_Data\HeliAnalysis): runHeliAnalysis.m (master, edit flightName), loadHeliMatData.m (loads only LR110 consolidated), cleanAndAlignHeliData.m (masks validity==0 as NaN, interpolates onto common 32 Hz grid), computeHeliStats.m (N, mean, std, min, max, median, P5, P95, RMS), plotHeliSummary.m (2-page PDF: track/altitude/ground-speed/vertical-speed/heading/wind; roll-pitch/body rates/accelerations/velocities). Outputs -> <flight>\HeliAnalysisResults\: alignedData.mat, summaryStats.mat, statsSummary.csv, HeliFlightReport.pdf.

DART 2.6 TOOL (local Flight_Data\DART_2.6, GUIDE GUI, targets R2014a, Leonardo): DART_Launcher.m (singleton via figure Tag ThisIsDARTgui), Utils\DART.m (~4900-line GUI controller; handles FlightPath, DataType, TopListBox, SelectedVarToPlot, StandAloneValidity, FigureSavingModes), Utils\Fcn\DARTreproduction_FigureGenerator.m (figure engine, 34 inputs: analog/boolean/enumerate lists, FMS, TOP division, conversions, PNG/FIG save), Utils\Fcn\OfficialLoadAndConcatenate.m (loader with global VAR cache, TOP concatenation), XDTS_2_DART_Conversion.m, fft_function.m, Spectrogram_function.m, UTCTimeManager.m, AW_189_TOP_REORDER.m. Analysis auto-save to Utils\Fcn\AutosavedAnalysis.

DART_Analysis_System (local Flight_Data\DART_Analysis_System): shared state files task_plan.md (coordinator-only write), findings.md, progress.md; DART_Analysis_Plan.md master plan; Agents\README.md role contracts (COORDINATOR, FUNCTIONAL ANALYST, PLOTTING ENGINEER, PILOT EXPERT); Knowledge\ with SANDRAmatdata format doc and signal_catalog.csv (built by matlab\buildSignalCatalog.m). Plan: headless figure engine reusing DART patterns without the GUI.

MATLAB MCP: R2024b at C:\Program Files\MATLAB\R2024b\bin\matlab.exe; use tools.MATLAB.evaluate_matlab_code / run_matlab_file / detect_matlab_toolboxes; NEVER restoredefaultpath (breaks MCP). ~60 toolboxes incl. Signal Processing, Stats & ML, Aerospace, Sensor Fusion & Tracking, Parallel Computing.

LOCAL REPO: work moved to C:\Users\49359\Documents\MATLAB\Flight_Data (git repo initialized; git identity Francesco Maggiulli <francesco.maggiulli@leonardo.com>). Note: a git system-config referenced an unreachable network UNC path (broken worktree reference) - if git throws UNC errors, run with env GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1.

EXPLORERS: explorer on X:\FLIGHT_ACTIVITY\Flight_Data_Plotting_Tools\DART_2.0\Analysis_Examples_DO was CANCELLED (path possibly not reachable) - DART 2.0 examples still unexplored. Explorer on DART_2.6 local + HeliAnalysis completed (see above).

FLT_803 ANALYSIS RESULTS (HeliAnalysis pipeline, 2026-09-30). 37 LR110 consolidated signals, 378 s flight (~6.3 min), 32 Hz, 12,099 samples per signal.
Altitude MSL: 703-1510 ft (mean 1,148). Ground speed: 0-139 kt (mean 102 kt). Roll: -19.4 to +32.3 deg (mean 1.5). Pitch: -1.8 to +20.3 deg (mean 3.9). Vertical speed: -1,036 to +261 ft/min (mean -131). Wind: 1.2-14.1 kt (mean 5.6 kt, from ~310 deg T). Position: 45.61 N, 8.83 E (Varese/Lonate - Leonardo test area).
Functional reading: controlled cruise test flight; moderate maneuvers (turns up to ~30 deg roll, climb pitch 20 deg); no high-energy maneuvers (accelerations < 0.35 g); AFCS stable (no divergent oscillations); controlled descent to -1,000 ft/min (approach/transition); multiple turns (heading varies +-100 deg); crosswind compensation active (track ~ heading, across-heading velocity < +-10 kt). No SSM/FAIL_CODE alarms.
Report: Flt_803\HeliAnalysisResults\HeliFlightReport.pdf (2.1 MB, 2 pages); alignedData.mat 3.7 MB; statsSummary.csv; summaryStats.mat.
